findings.title: Admit a fresh cleanup attempt before requiring captured compensation on the pre-attempt intent-change branch
source_proof: reconcileLease lines280/286 enters failAfterCleanup before normal prepare at288.
ClaimReconciliation creates an unattempted private reservation with empty captured proof.
failAfterCleanup line416 calls compensation; repository lines374-376 refuses empty captured proof.
Deferred finishPreparation can create only a secret_failure attempt, then next retry creates a fresh unattempted reservation; it does not perform the requested discard/fail transition.
findings.impact: For a genuine attributed authorize origin whose current workflow/scopes/request intent changed, existing original cleanup and terminal authorization_intent_changed behavior cannot complete in the selected native adapter. It retries until finite exhaustion/quarantine, without the intended provider discard. This is a source defect, not an assertion about a hosted failure.
findings.required_fix: Before an outbound discard for a newly reserved genuine origin, explicitly authorize and begin a fresh bounded provider cleanup attempt with current grantor AND service/task authority, updating the local lease attempt and retaining the native captured receipt. Existing already-attempted compensation must continue using only its exact captured proof. Do not admit originless work, fabricate receipts, bypass live checks or turn an unattempted cleanup into captured compensation.
